premises.text: Patients are waiting months to get their results back due to insufficient diagnostics.
premises.evidence_span: Patients are waiting months to get their results back.

premises.text: Current diagnostic solutions are either not sensitive enough or too costly.
premises.evidence_span: the dipstick test, similar to the pregnancy test, is affordable. However, it's not sensitive enough to detect early case detection. And the PCR, though it's very sensitive, it is very costly.

premises.text: The fast chip technology can provide rapid diagnostics without the need for external power.
premises.evidence_span: The chip requires zero power because everything is driven by vacuum.

premises.text: The fast chip can deliver results within one hour.
premises.evidence_span: Results come out within one hour, so patients don't have to wait for days to get the results.

premises.text: The technology is more affordable and low-cost compared to PCR solutions.
